assertion_audit.failure_condition: Counting the service, counting the foreign allocation, exempting a heavy tree, double-counting the nested runner, dropping helper RSS or misrouting the inherited run changes the independent constants 2 trees, 5 processes, 18432 bytes, 9216 bytes per owner or the seeded session identities.
Omitting or corrupting the persisted JSON makes disk content differ from the returned sample; this checks persistence, not independent numerical correctness, which preceding assertions provide.
Restoring a command-text pytest substring matcher recognizes a service, a script argument or an unevaluated shell command as a runner instead of returning None.

Removing each file-count, worker-count, elapsed-time, CPU-time or executed-runner check flips the expected tree-count decision for at least one parameterized case; light is a test expectation and is never passed to the function.
Considering only root CPU exempts the 31+30 second descendant tree and changes the asserted tree count from 1 to 0.
Restoring the first commit calculation without reaped-child ticks changes expected CPU 71 to 1 and wrongly exempts the tree.

A shell CLI failure, missing or incorrectly serialized new columns, lost run attribution, absent alert or absent snapshot fails the corresponding return-code, fixed-value, run-id, alert-text or snapshot-count assertion.
Letting failed sampler execution abort fleet-health fails returncode; representing failure as numeric zero fails both independent unknown-field assertions.

Dropping duties fails length 2; omitting command or run attribution fails literal substrings; removing project, session, age or current-job filters fails the corresponding empty-list assertion; returning stale duties for an explicit empty sample fails the final empty-list assertion.

Removing the direct integration fails independent length 2; removing or changing only the station integration fails composition equality, which supplements the independent direct count and the separately tested duty contents.

assertion_independence: No assertion uses an expected output value passed unchanged as the same output to the code under test; persistence equality and composition equality are deliberately round-trip/parity checks supplemented by independent fixed-value assertions.

failure_evidence.note: This delta is the armed baseline_suite/after_suite pair; the broader importer comparison is recorded separately.
